## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (unit, regression, or conformance as applicable)
- [ ] Linked issue, RFC, or ADR (if applicable)
- [ ] Documentation updated (if this changes a normative contract)
- [ ] `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm test` pass locally
- [ ] Did this change investigate a challenge to an existing claim? If yes, has a ChallengeRecord been created? (RFC-0022)
